name: gamenet_end_chat_compose_and_send
description: GameNet::EndChatComposeAndSend exits chat compose mode, locally echoes non-empty chat text as player-name-prefixed text, and sends packet 0x0B.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet chat/HUD input source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x414590 validates clearing chatComposeActive, popping the bind-map overlay, calling HudUiMgrObjective::Begin, skipping empty text buffers, constructing an 0x51-byte stack chat line with a final guard zero, strncpy of the local row displayName, strncat of ':' and the chat input with 0x50-minus-current-length limits, local HudUi::ShowChatLine for 5.0 seconds, and GameNet::SendPkt0B_ChatMessage.

The native end-chat-compose smoke verifies a non-empty compose buffer becomes 'displayName:message', is shown locally for 5.0 seconds, sends a reliable packet with the local player key and exact message bytes, clears compose state, pops the input overlay, and skips local echo/send for an empty buffer.
